1: // Simple Neon Runner game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
8: 
9:   const GRAVITY = 0.6, JUMP = -12, SPEED = 4;
10:   let score = 0, lives = 3, running = true;
11: 
12:   const player = { x: 80, y: canvas.height - 30, r: 12, vy: 0, onGround: true };
13:   const obstacles = [], shards = [];
14:   let frame = 0;
15: 
16:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
17:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
18:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y: canvas.height - h, w: 20, h });
19:   };
20:   const spawnShard = () => {
21:     const size = 8;
22:     const y = canvas.height - 30 - Math.random() * 120;
23:     shards.push({ x: canvas.width, y, size });
24:   };
25: 
26:   const rectCollision = (p, o) => {
27:     const distX = Math.abs(p.x - o.x - o.w / 2);
28:     const distY = Math.abs(p.y - o.y - o.h / 2);
29:     return distX <= o.w / 2 + p.r && distY <= o.h / 2 + p.r;
30:   };
31:   const circleCollision = (p, s) => {
32:     const dx = p.x - s.x; const dy = p.y - s.y;
33:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < (p.r + s.size) ** 2;
34:   };
35: 
36:   const update = () => {
37:     // player physics
38:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
39:     player.y += player.vy;
40:     if (player.y >= canvas.height - player.r) {
41:       player.y = canvas.height - player.r;
42:       player.vy = 0;
43:       player.onGround = true;
44:     }
45:     // obstacles movement
46:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SPEED);
47:     shards.forEach(s => s.x -= SPEED);
48:     // spawn logic
49:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
50:     if (frame % 180 === 0) spawnShard();
51:     // collision detection
52:     obstacles.forEach((o, i) => {
53:       if (rectCollision(player, o)) {
54:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
55:         lives--;
56:         if (lives <= 0) running = false;
57:       }
58:     });
59:     shards.forEach((s, i) => {
60:       if (circleCollision(player, s)) {
61:         shards.splice(i, 1);
62:         score += 10;
63:       }
64:     });
65:     // cleanup offscreen
66:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
67:     while (shards.length && shards[0].x + shards[0].size < 0) shards.shift();
68:     frame++;
69:   };
70: 
71:   const draw = () => {
72:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
73:     // background grid
74:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
75:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
76:     // player
77:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
78:     ctx.beginPath();
79:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
80:     ctx.fill();
81:     // obstacles
82:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
83:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
84:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
85:     });
86:     // shards
87:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
88:     shards.forEach(s => {
89:       ctx.beginPath();
90:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
91:       ctx.fill();
92:     });
93:     // UI
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
95:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
96:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
97:     ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${lives}`, 10, 40);
98:   };
99: 
100:   const loop = () => {
101:     if (!running) { ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 40, canvas.height / 2); return; }
102:     update();
103:     draw();
104:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
105:   };
106: 
107:   // input
108:   const onJump = (e) => {
109:     if (player.onGround) {
110:       player.vy = JUMP;
111:       player.onGround = false;
112:     }
113:   };
114:   canvas.addEventListener('click', onJump);
115:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', onJump);
116: 
117:   loop();
118: })();

(End of file - total 118 lines)
</content>
